groups.description: Official sites of the platforms aggregated here.

links.title: Highbiza
links.relevance: Managed webshops and websites for wholesalers, technical wholesalers, retailers and jewellers, with customer-specific B2B pricing, quotes, reorder and ERP, carrier and marketplace integrations.

links.title: EffectConnect
links.relevance: One hub that connects webshops, back offices and SaaS partners to 50+ European marketplaces for listings, content, repricing, orders, stock, fulfilment, feeds and retail media reporting.

links.title: Vendit
links.relevance: Point-of-sale, stock, webshop and store management for Dutch and Belgian specialty retailers, chains and franchise formulas.

links.title: Logic4
links.relevance: All-in-one webshop and ERP for mid-sized Dutch and Belgian non-food wholesalers, retailers and e-tailers: PIM, orders, stock, purchasing, CRM, POS and accounting in one system.

links.title: Transus
links.relevance: EDI and e-invoicing network connecting suppliers, retailers and logistics partners for orders, despatch advice, SSCC labels, invoices and VMI.

links.title: Picqer
links.relevance: Cloud WMS for online stores, wholesalers and fulfilment companies: multi-channel orders, inventory and locations, purchasing, batch picking, packing, returns, rules and a multi-client fulfilment portal.

links.title: DeliveryMatch
links.relevance: Order and shipping platform: dynamic checkout, multi-carrier booking across 200+ carriers, transport management, tracking, return shipping and freight audit.

links.title: Returnista
links.relevance: Branded returns portal, exchanges and store credit, return operations and returns insights for European webshops.
